name: Nischitartham
caption: Ep 10/10 FINALE 🎉 Divya engagement, Bunty sorry, Dost hero. Season 2 kavala? Comment 'S2' 👇 Call/WhatsApp 79934 34932 #DostUndiGa #IronDost #HyderabadReels #TeluguComedy #AIVideo

clips.title: Hero walk
beats: Frame 1, slow motion: RAVI in the cream silk pancha with its thin gold border and the crisp navy checked lucky shirt, and BUNTY beside him in a crisp white kurta-pyjama, walk toward the lens through falling jasmine petals under warm fairy lights.
BUNTY smooths his kurta and grins sideways at RAVI; RAVI tugs his shirt cuff straight, chin up.
The two walk past either side of the camera; the camera keeps moving forward between them toward the decorated stage.

On the stage, DIVYA stands seen from behind in the maroon Kanchipuram saree with perfect pleats; she turns slightly at a mirror and the wide gold zari border catches the light. Her face stays soft and out of focus.
clips.camera: Low-angle slow-motion push toward RAVI and BUNTY, passing between them and continuing forward to DIVYA on the stage. One continuous move.

lines.en: Mummy! It looks like a new saree!

clips.sound: Big drum hit at 0.0 s, slow-motion whoosh of petals, a bright zari shimmer at 7.5 s. No music.
clips.first: RAVI and BUNTY already mid-stride in slow motion, jasmine petals falling around them.
clips.last: DIVYA from behind on the stage, the gold zari border of the maroon saree glinting, face out of focus.
neg_extra: a crowd of guests on screen
the saree turning red or losing its gold border
a banner or text on the stage

clips.title: Amma's blessing
beats: Over AMMA's shoulder, seen from behind (silk saree, bun with jasmine): she cups RAVI's cheek. RAVI smiles shyly and looks down.
RAVI shakes his head and points at BUNTY, who stands beside him and scratches his head, embarrassed.
BUNTY steps forward and bends down to touch AMMA's feet.
Still bent, BUNTY says sorry. AMMA's hand rests on his head in blessing.
BUNTY straightens up with wet eyes and a smile; RAVI puts an arm round his shoulders.
clips.camera: Over-the-shoulder from behind AMMA, a slow drift to include BUNTY and a slight tilt down as he bends. One continuous move. AMMA is only ever seen from behind.

lines.en: Not me, Amma. Bunty and Dost.

lines.native: आंटी, ग़लती मेरी थी, दोस्त ने बचा लिया.
lines.roman: Aunty, galti meri thi, Dost ne bacha liya.
lines.en: Aunty, the mistake was mine, Dost saved us.

clips.sound: Soft bangle jingle at 0.3 s, silk rustle as BUNTY bends at 5 s, BUNTY's small sniff at 9.3 s. No music.
clips.first: AMMA's jasmine bun and shoulder in the foreground, her hand already on RAVI's cheek.
clips.last: BUNTY standing up with wet eyes, RAVI's arm round him, AMMA's hand lowering.
clips.edit_text: Kinetic captions for all three lines
neg_extra: BUNTY falling over when he bends
more than three people in frame

clips.title: Stay and eat, and the ring
beats: DOST walks quietly toward the hall exit with folded empty royal-blue garment bags under his arm. AMMA's voice calls him; he stops and turns back, surprised.
DOST, smiling shyly, sits down at the long dining table between RAVI and BUNTY, a banana leaf in front of each of them. BUNTY heaps a big spoonful of rice onto DOST's leaf; all three laugh.
A drop of sambar flicks up toward RAVI's navy checked shirt; RAVI catches it on his palm just in time and BUNTY mock-gasps.
RAVI wipes his hand, pulls the small red velvet ring box out of his shirt pocket and opens it. A gold ring sparkles under the warm lights.
DOST taps RAVI's shirt pocket with one finger and smiles; RAVI and BUNTY laugh.
clips.camera: Follows DOST from behind toward the exit, swings round with him as he turns, then glides to a medium three-shot at the dining table and pushes in to the ring box. One continuous move.
clips.sound: Footsteps at 0.0 s, AMMA's voice from off screen, a leaf rustle and rice plop at 3 s, three-way laughter at 3.5 s, BUNTY's mock gasp at 5.3 s, the ring box creak at 7 s, a sparkle 'ting' and distant applause at 7.5 s. No music.
clips.first: DOST mid-step toward the exit with folded royal-blue bags under his arm.
clips.last: The open red ring box in RAVI's hand by his shirt pocket, the gold ring sparkling, all three laughing.
clips.edit_text: 3 s: 'Bhojanam ✓'. 7.5 s: callback tag 'Ep 3: every pocket checked'
neg_extra: the ring box turning into a phone or wallet
more than three people at the table
a logo or text on the bags

clips.title: Taglines and the Season 2 tease
beats: RAVI, in the pancha and the navy checked lucky shirt, looks straight into the lens with a big confident smile, says his tagline and winks.
BUNTY squeezes into the frame cheek to cheek with RAVI, grinning, and says his tagline.
BUNTY's phone buzzes. He looks down at it (its back to the camera, a faint glow on his face) and his grin freezes.
BUNTY looks slowly up at the lens with a nervous grin and speaks. RAVI turns to stare at him, eyebrows raised.
clips.camera: Medium close-up two-shot to the lens, with one slow continuous push in onto BUNTY's nervous grin.

lines.native: कपड़ों की टेंशन? दोस्त है ना!
lines.roman: Kapdon ki tension? Dost hai na!

clips.sound: A little whoosh as BUNTY squeezes in at 3 s, phone buzz at 6 s, comedy sting at 9.5 s. No music.
clips.first: RAVI already smiling into the lens in the pancha and lucky shirt.
clips.last: BUNTY's nervous grin to the lens, RAVI staring at him sideways.
clips.edit_text: 0.5 s: 'Battala tension? IronDost undi ga!' 3.5 s: 'Kapdon ki tension? Dost hai na!' 6.3 s: phone mock-up graphic 'Ayesha 💕: Ammi-Abba ko milna hai. Sunday.' 8.5 s: 'Bhai… Season 2.' then the end card
neg_extra: a visible phone screen or chat
